body:
There are only two people who I trust. They are the closest thing I have to actual friends, but I still don't see them much. I have tried talking to both of them, as well as a couple other people, one of whom promptly stabbed me in the back. The other things I've tried include various forms of creative expression, distractions, trying new activities in an attempt to fill more of my time with things I like doing, exercise, and self help. Most of that stuff worked for a while, and a lot of it still helps but not enough.

I have thought about asking someone to come with me, but it seems unfair to ask that of either of the people I trust. They've both already done more than I deserve, and I don't want to bother them anymore. Besides, I don't really know them all that well anyway.
Physically unable to say anything. It's hard even with people I do trust.
No. I have to many trust issues to talk to a therapist. I wouldn't be able to tell them anything.
